name: Companionship
overview: Scripture reveals that companionship is essential to human flourishing, as God Himself declared it was not good for man to be alone and provided a suitable helper for him (Genesis 2:18). The intimate union of marriage is highlighted as a divine design where a man leaves his parents and cleaves to his wife, becoming one flesh (Genesis 2:24). Wisdom is also found in choosing companions wisely, for walking with the wise leads to wisdom, while foolish company results in destruction (Proverbs 13:20). True friendship requires showing friendliness and yields deep bonds, with some friends sticking closer than brothers, sharpening and encouraging one another (Proverbs 18:24; 27:17). Moreover, finding a wife is portrayed as a good thing that brings favor from the Lord (Proverbs 18:22).
